comment: FIRST AID BY WOUND TIER (the game designer 2026-11-16, feat/first-aid; docs/port/FIRST_AID_REPORT.md). Read by FirstAidRules::GetConfig (Source/CodexTactics/Public/Survival/FirstAidRules.h) at game start; the code defaults mirror these values (test CodexTactics.Survival.FirstAid.DataFile). The medkit / medical bag is a TIMED TREATMENT: a clip of the healing pack plays on the ABP's FullBody slot and the heal lands at 'apply_at' of the treatment's length (the item is used up there). TIERS (the designer's words): light = wounded (under 50 % HP, critical_wound.json heavy_from 35 % and above) -> he treats HIMSELF STANDING; medium = critical_wound.json 'heavy' tier (35..20 %, holds his side, limps) -> himself KNEELING / SITTING; heavy = critical (under 20 %, lying / crawling) -> he CANNOT treat himself: a mate drags the medkit / bag onto him (his model or portrait) and treats him; none = hurt but not wounded -> like light. Prone (not heavy): the self_lying clips.
consume_comment: consume_on_cancel false: a treatment interrupted BEFORE the apply moment keeps the item; after it the item was used (the heal landed).
cancel_comment: Interruptions: damage >= cancel_min_damage HP in one tick (the cold's per-frame loss stays under it) to the helper or the patient, a move / stance order for either, either body displaced > move_tolerance_cm from his spot, the helper > reach_cm (+ tolerance) from the patient, the helper dead / knocked down, the patient dead, the helper's walk over failed / took > approach_timeout_s.
drop_comment: A medkit / medical bag dragged from the drawer onto a mate of these tiers whose HP is below max TREATS him (he walks up first). Designer 2026-11-17: any wound, including a scratch (tier none). Shift held, or a mate at full HP, hands it over. A tier left out of the list stays a hand-over.

patient.comment: THE LYING PATIENT of a mate's aid (the game designer 2026-11-17, R17-6: several variants; the old transition spun the body around). The patient's clip set is picked by the pose he is in when the treatment starts (FirstAidRules::ChoosePatientPose): crawl = on all fours (wounded + prone: the injured crawl idle, the critical wound), prone = flat on the belly (prone, not wounded: the prone crawl idle), sitting = crouching (he sits down on the ground), none = standing (no clip, he keeps his pose), knockdown = knocked down: the knockdown owns the FullBody slot, so the aid WAITS until he is up / lying still and reads the pose again. One clip of the pose's list at random (not the same one twice in a row; an empty / missing list -> the item's 'patient' list for a lying pose). A name with a folder ('Injured/Idle_Crawl_Injured1') is /Game/Characters/Animations/<Folder>/{Male,Female}/<Name> (the CON_Injured / crawl copies other setup scripts made); a plain name is a healing-pack copy in FirstAid/. The SPIN: measured (Scripts/Editor/setup_first_aid_animation.py, long axis = pelvis -> head as an actor yaw, clockwise from the body's forward) the crawl / prone idles lie along the body's forward (-3..+3 deg, belly down) but AS_WoundedGetInjection / AS_WoundedLying lie on the LEFT SIDE with the head back-left (-152 male / -155 female): blending into them in 0.25 s swung the body ~150 deg. Now the patient's capsule is never turned toward anybody: hold_body_heading counter-turns his capsule by the body's turn at the clip's blend weight (in and out): long_axis_curve = that turn at weights 0, 0.1 .. 1 over the pose's first clip (the slot blends LOCAL bone rotations, so it is S-shaped, not linear: a linear counter-turn left a 77 deg/s wobble - measured by setup_first_aid_animation.py 'blend curves', both bodies averaged; without a curve long_axis_deg x weight), so the lying body keeps the line it lay on (the head stays where it was, ~50 cm from the capsule both ways) - limited to counter_turn_max_deg_s; the HELPER walks to the lying patient's side instead (helper_beside_lying: approach_stop_cm out to the side he comes from, helper_chest_cm toward the patient's head) and turns to face that point at helper_turn_deg_s (0 = at once, the old snap). Blends: the pose's blend_in_s / blend_out_s, a clip's own in clip_data (the lie-down onto the side slow: 1.8 / 1.6 s); fit_rate false = the idle plays at its own speed and loops (true: fitted to the treatment like the other clips, min_play_rate..max_play_rate). end: 'stand' = after a COMPLETED aid that left him able to stand (no longer critical) he gets up once the patient clip has blended out (the stance clip prone -> stand, from the belly-down crawl pose it starts from); 'stay' = he keeps his stance. max_body_turn_deg_s: the bound FirstAidSmoke checks on the patient's visible body (the long axis, 0.2 s windows) through the whole transition.

medkit.items_comment: heal: HP added; tier_steps: the wound improves at least this many tiers (the health is raised to that tier's floor + 0.5 HP); self_seconds / aid_seconds: the treatment's length per tier (a tier left out = not allowed that way); apply_at: the share of the treatment when the heal lands; max_carried 0 = no limit; weight_kg: data only (the inventory has no weight limit yet). clips: the healing pack's clip names (/Game/HealingAnimations/Animations), played from the retargeted copies /Game/Characters/Animations/FirstAid/{Male,Female}/<name> - after adding a name run Scripts/Editor/setup_first_aid_animation.py. One clip is picked at random per treatment (not the same one twice in a row). 'patient' = the fallback for a lying patient when the 'patient' block's pose list is empty / missing.
